abstract: During the past 21 years, 105 patients with germinal testicular tumor were treated in our hospital; 86 out of 105 patients were irradiated postoperatively. Late radiation injury was observed in 14 patients: Cutaneosigmoidal fistula in 1 patient, ileus (jejunum necrosis) in 1 patient, gastric ulcer in 1 patient, duodenal ulcer and stenosis in 1 patient, lung fibrosis in 1 patient, radiation cystitis in 1 patient, severe lymph edema of lower extremity in 1 patient, muscle atrophy of lower extremity in 1 patient, lower extremity growth disturbances in 3 children and severe abdominal cutaneosubcutaneal fibrosis in 3 patient. Two cases of late radiation injury are presented and discussed.
abstract_ja: 過去21年間に、当院で精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者105例を治療した。105例中86例が術後に放射線療法を受けた。14例に晩期放射線障害を認めた。内訳は皮膚S状結腸瘻1例、イレウス（空腸壊死）1例、胃潰瘍1例、十二指腸潰瘍および狭窄1例、肺線維症1例、放射線膀胱炎1例、下肢の重度リンパ浮腫1例、下肢の筋萎縮1例、小児3例の下肢成長障害、腹部皮膚皮下線維症重度3例である。晩期放射線障害の2症例を提示し、考察する。
